glosses: repair; the act of repairing, fixing, or mending something
a business specialized in repairing, often of specific sorts of objects

examples.text: Eu conserto computadores quase todos os dias.
examples.en: I repair computers almost every day.

examples.text: Só faça os consertos necessários, por favor.
examples.en: Just do the essential repairs, please.

examples.text: Tenho que mandar meu carro para o conserto.
examples.en: I've got to get my car fixed.
